zh: 铃响了她还在说个不停。
en: She {kept on|carried on|went on|kept} talking even after the bell rang.

zh: 她一口气说出了欧洲所有国家的首都。
en: She {rattled off|reeled off|listed|recited} every capital city in Europe without stopping.

zh: 我在解释的时候她一直插嘴。
en: She kept {cutting in|butting in|interrupting|jumping in} while I was trying to explain.

zh: 吵了一个小时以后，他终于让步了。
en: After an hour of arguing, he finally {backed down|gave in|gave up|caved|gave way|relented}.

zh: 他装作自己生病了，其实只是不想来上班。
en: He {made out|pretended} that he was sick, but he just didn't want to come to work.

zh: 我讨厌别人用居高临下的语气跟我说话。
en: I hate it when people {talk down to|patronise|patronize} me.

zh: 我不是故意说的，就是嘴快说漏了。
en: I didn't mean to say it. It just {slipped out}.

zh: 他总是在背后贬低同事。
我们先听听双方怎么说，再做决定。
en: Let's {hear out|listen to} both sides before we decide.

zh: 他编了个借口解释自己为什么迟到。
en: He {made up|invented|came up with} an excuse for being late.

zh: 我一问起他前女友，他就不吭声了。
en: He {clammed up|shut up|went quiet} when I asked about his ex.

zh: 他特别喜欢给人提建议。
en: He loves {dishing out|handing out|giving out|giving} advice.

zh: 我收回刚才的话，你是对的。
en: I {take back} what I said. You were right.

zh: 不好意思打断一下，你的出租车到了。
en: Sorry to {butt in|interrupt|cut in|jump in}, but your taxi's here.

zh: 他老是唠唠叨叨地说他的新皮卡。
en: He's always {banging on about|going on about|harping on about|rabbiting on about} his new ute.

zh: 她说着说着声音就越来越小了。
en: Her voice {trailed off|tailed off|faded away|faded} as she spoke.

zh: 他说话不算数，违背了承诺。
别有所保留，告诉我你的真实想法。
en: Don't {hold back}, tell me what you really think.
